hooks.command: bash -lc 'payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$payload" ] || exit 0; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cwd=$(printf "%s" "$payload" | jq -r ".cwd // empty" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$cwd" ] || cwd=$PWD; dir=$(cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0; root=; while :; do if [ -x "$dir/bin/fm-turnend-guard.sh" ] && [ -f "$dir/AGENTS.md" ] && [ -f "$dir/.codex/hooks.json" ] && jq -e "any(.hooks.Stop[]?.hooks[]?.command?; type == \"string\" and contains(\"fm-turnend-guard.sh\"))" "$dir/.codex/hooks.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then root=$dir; fi; parent=$(dirname "$dir"); [ "$parent" = "$dir" ] && break; dir=$parent; done; [ -n "$root" ] || exit 0; printf "%s" "$payload" | "$root/bin/fm-turnend-guard.sh"'
